helperCasing.framing: Independently for input and output append uint32 little-endian cp, then uint32 little-endian length of text.encode(UTF8,strict), then those bytes. SHA256 starts empty per plane/recipe. No BOM, separator, terminator or normalization.

limitations: Exact frozen CaseConverter schema, finalization, acquisition, binder, mapper, execute and NodeOutput. The unchanged body uses actual CPython str.upper/lower/capitalize/title and returns string unchanged for invalid modes. No C# output or table is read.

Exact typed values, metadata, order and observation snapshots for the 28 comparable cases. The eight actual AttributeError observations remain distinct from local typed diagnostics and engine STRING coercion. The four invalid-mode identity observations remain separate from local COMBO rejection; no invented Boolean, missing output or exception.

Only a sole $blocker in cached fixture data decodes to the actual source ExecutionBlocker. Prompt dictionaries remain ordinary data. Return encoding preserves scalars/containers and explicitly records dictionary order.
Off runs retain hashes only; middle raw records permit independent hash recomputation.
Interpreter executable hash does not attest every dynamic Python library.
85 casing digests do not exhaust every multi-character Unicode context.
